description: This file defines a Prometheus collector for machine metrics in the cadvisor project, including metrics for CPU, memory, NUMA topology, and NVM info.

classes.name: machineMetric
classes.description: Represents a multi-dimensional machine metric with properties like name, help text, value type, labels, condition, and value extraction function.

classes.name: PrometheusMachineCollector
classes.description: Implements prometheus.Collector to collect and expose machine metrics such as CPU, memory, NUMA topology, and NVM info.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: Creates a Prometheus description for the metric with given base labels.

methods.name: NewPrometheusMachineCollector
methods.description: Constructs a new PrometheusMachineCollector with specified info provider and metric set.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Describes all metrics for Prometheus to scrape.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Collects machine info and sends metrics to the provided channel.

methods.name: collectMachineInfo
methods.description: Fetches machine info and generates metrics based on current data.
